sn12.55:1.2: Upādāniyesu bhikkhave dhammesu assādānupassino viharato taṇhā pavaḍḍhati ||
sn12.55:1.5: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti || || 3
sn12.55:2.2: tassa yāni ceva mūlāni adhogamāniyāni ca tiriyaṅgamāni sabbān tāni uddham ojam abhiharanti ||
sn12.55:2.3: Evañ hi so bhikkhave mahārukkho tadāhāro tadupādāno ciraṃ dīgham addhānaṃ tiṭṭheyya || ||
sn12.55:2.4: Evam eva kho bhikkhave upādāniyesu dhammesu assādānupassino viharato taṇhā pavaḍḍhati ||
sn12.55:2.6: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hoti || || 4
sn12.55:3.1: Upādāniyesu bhikkhave dhammesu ādīnavānupassino viharato taṇhā nirujjhati ||
sn12.55:3.4: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hoti || || 5
sn12.55:4.3: so taṃ rukkhaṃ mūle chindeyya || mulena chetvā paliṃ khaṇeyya || paliṃ khaṇitvā mulāni uddhareyya antamaso usīraṇāḷimattānipi ||
sn12.55:4.4: so taṃ rukkhaṃ khaṇḍākhaṇḍikaṃ chindeyya || khaṇḍākhaṇḍikaṃ chetvā phāleyya || phāletvā sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ kareyya || sakalikam sakalikaṃ karitvā vātātape visoseyya ||
sn12.55:4.5: vātātape visosetvā agginā ḍaheyya || agginā ḍahitvā masiṃ kareyya || masiṃ karitvā mahāvāte vā opuneyya || nadiyāvā sīghasotāya pavāheyya || ||
sn12.55:4.6: Evañhi so bhikkhave mahārukkho ucchinnamūlo assa || tālavatthukato anabhāvaṃkato āyatim anuppādadhammo || || 6
sn12.55:4.7: Evam eva kho bhikkhave upādāniyesu dhammesu ādīnavānuppassino viharato taṇhā nirujjhati ||
sn12.55:4.10: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hotīti || ||
